entries.meaningZh: 眼中钉（此处指因外观难看而碍眼的事物）
entries.en: The ugly shed remained an eyesore to the neighbours.
entries.zh: 那间难看的棚屋一直是邻居们的眼中钉。

entries.meaningZh: 笨蛋（主要用于方言，贬义）
entries.en: The old farmer muttered, "What a loggerhead I am!" after leaving his keys inside the locked shed.
entries.zh: 老农把钥匙锁进棚屋后，嘀咕道：“我真是个笨蛋！”
